title: Plan business continuity and alternate operations
summary: When a disruption could stop critical business activities or key dependencies change. An exercised continuity plan covering owners, alternate operations and a controlled return to normal.
outcomes: An exercised continuity plan covering owners, alternate operations and a controlled return to normal.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a disruption could stop critical business activities or key dependencies change.

parts.title: Assess business impacts and dependencies
parts.guidance: List critical customer, payment, workforce and supplier activities and the effects of their loss over time. Record required people, systems, premises, information and counterparties rather than focusing only on servers.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Agree continuity priorities and authority
parts.guidance: Leadership selects tolerable disruption, minimum operating capability, decision owners and escalation routes. Review safety, legal, financial and customer constraints before choosing workarounds.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Prepare alternate operating and communication plans
parts.guidance: Document approved manual or alternate workflows, contact routes, supplier options and restoration dependencies. Protect sensitive information and define which commitments or changes still require separate approval.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Exercise a realistic disruption scenario
parts.guidance: Run a tabletop or approved practical test with the relevant owners and alternates. Capture decisions, unavailable dependencies and customer or staff communication issues without causing an unapproved production interruption.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Close gaps and define return-to-normal checks
parts.guidance: Assign fixes and verify that alternate work can be reconciled with restored systems. Record the authority and evidence needed to return to normal and refresh the plan after material business changes.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An exercised continuity plan covering owners, alternate operations and a controlled return to normal.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
